definitions.explanation: Expressing high approval or admiration for someone's actions, achievements, or qualities. A relatively formal word used in both spoken and written contexts.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{勇気|ゆうき}は{賞賛|しょうさん}に{値|あたい}する。
examples.english: His courage is worthy of praise.

examples.japanese: {世界中|せかいじゅう}から{賞賛|しょうさん}の{声|こえ}が{寄|よ}せられた。
examples.english: Voices of praise came from around the world.

examples.japanese: ボランティア{活動|かつどう}に{長年|ながねん}{取|と}り{組|く}んできた{彼女|かのじょ}を、{地域|ちいき}の{人々|ひとびと}は{賞賛|しょうさん}した。
examples.english: The local community praised her for her many years of volunteer work.

notes:
Can function as both a noun and a する verb ({賞賛|しょうさん}する = to praise). More formal than {褒|ほ}める and carries a stronger sense of admiration.

Also written as {称賛|しょうさん} with the same meaning and pronunciation. Both kanji variants are standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {賞賛|しょうさん}に{値|あたい}する (to be worthy of praise)
- {賞賛|しょうさん}の{声|こえ} (voices of praise)
- {賞賛|しょうさん}を{浴|あ}びる (to receive praise)
- {賞賛|しょうさん}を{送|おく}る (to offer praise)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {褒|ほ}める: to praise (everyday, conversational)
- {称|たた}える: to extol, to honor (literary, ceremonial)
- {絶賛|ぜっさん}: overwhelming praise, rave reviews
